segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Hi, this is Vikram from Kosha Capital. I saw that you applied for a business loan on our website.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Yes, I need about twenty lakh rupees for my shop.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Great. Do not worry, the approval is guaranteed for you, and the interest rate will be only twelve percent.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Yes, one hundred percent. You will definitely get the loan.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Okay. What documents do you need from me?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Just your PAN card, Aadhaar, and twelve months of bank statements.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: And what is the processing fee?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: It is very small, I will tell you later.
